Composer\\Console\\Application.reason: the worker hosts plugin commands under a genuine Symfony console application; the upstream class boots Composer itself, so a hand-written definition supplies the Composer-specific surface from the Rust side instead

Composer\\DependencyResolver\\Rule.reason: an abstract base class with no stub yet; the real definition stays so that its subclasses load

Composer\\Downloader\\ArchiveDownloader.reason: an abstract base class plugins extend, with no stub yet; the real definition stays so that plugin subclasses load

Composer\\Downloader\\VcsDownloader.reason: an abstract base class plugins extend, with no stub yet; the real definition stays so that plugin subclasses load

Composer\\EventDispatcher\\Event.reason: dual-mode: an instance revived from a Rust entity handle forwards to its entity, while one constructed in the worker runs the real code; a generated stub cannot be both

getComposerFile.reason: it only reads the COMPOSER environment variable, whose value the Rust side owns.

Composer\\Filter\\PlatformRequirementFil.reason: plugins build the filters Composer offers through it; fromBoolOrList() with a list reaches the guarded IgnoreListPlatformRequirementFilter

Composer\\Installer\\BinaryInstaller.reason: constructed by the real LibraryInstaller for the same plugin-owned instance; it holds only stubs (IO, Filesystem) and its own configuration strings

Composer\\Installer\\LibraryInstaller.reason: plugins subclass it to provide their own installers; an instance lives only in the worker, and the Rust side reaches it through the InstallerInterface reverse adapter once the plugin registers it; every service it holds is a stub, so the real code works on the entities the Rust side owns

Composer\\Package\\Version\\VersionGuess.reason: stateless computation over VCS output, reached only as a constructor parameter of RootPackageLoader; no Rust-side instance is ever handed to plugins

Composer\\Platform\\HhvmDetector.reason: stateless environment probe, reached only as a constructor parameter of PlatformRepository; no Rust-side instance is ever handed to plugins

Composer\\Plugin\\PreCommandRunEvent.reason: dual-mode, like its parent Event: the worker's real code constructs it natively, while the Rust side hands its own instances over as entities

Composer\\Repository\\Vcs\\VcsDriver.reason: an abstract base class plugins extend, with no stub yet; the real definition stays so that plugin subclasses load

Composer\\Util\\Http\\CurlDownloader.reason: the Rust-side HttpDownloader never uses it, so an instance plugin code builds is the real class running on the worker's own curl extension; its constructor reaches the guarded AuthHelper

Composer\\Util\\Http\\CurlResponse.reason: only CurlDownloader builds one, and that class runs as real code in the worker; the Rust-side HttpDownloader answers with a plain Response

Composer\\Util\\Loop.reason: the upstream body drives curl and process handles the worker does not own; the hand-written port runs over the HttpDownloader and ProcessExecutor stubs, a sibling of the Rust side's loop over one promise registry

Composer\\Util\\RemoteFilesystem.reason: the Rust-side HttpDownloader hands the requests it cannot serve itself to an instance of the real class in the worker, built with an AuthHelper it passes in; one built without reaches the guarded AuthHelper
